problem_context.input_output_contract: Require linklist != 0 and xizi_sll_head(linklist,l). Ensure ((l=nil and return=1) or (l!=nil and return=0)) and preserve xizi_sll_head(linklist,l).
spec_hint: Follow LOS_ListEmpty predicate-first style directly. Use the abstract sequence l to characterize emptiness rather than exposing the internal first pointer.
preferred_hidden_properties: xizi_sll_head(linklist,l) unfolds to first pointer ownership plus xizi_sll(first,l); xizi_sll(first,nil) forces first=NULL, while a nonempty l forces first non-NULL.
forbidden_patterns: Do not expose first as a With parameter; do not use only pointer equality without relating it to l; do not model the sentinel as a data node.
